title: A multiplication square
description:
Read a whole number n from 1 to 12 and print an n by n multiplication square. Every number takes 4 characters, right-aligned (`string.format("%4d", value)`), and each row is one line.

```
Size? 4
   1   2   3   4
   2   4   6   8
   3   6   9  12
   4   8  12  16
```

If the number is outside 1 to 12, print `Size must be 1 to 12.`

starter.main.lua:
io.write("Size? ")
local n = io.read("n")
for i = 1, n do
    print(i)
end

solution.main.lua:
io.write("Size? ")
local n = io.read("n")
if n < 1 or n > 12 then
    print("Size must be 1 to 12.")
else
    for row = 1, n do
        for col = 1, n do
            io.write(string.format("%4d", row * col))
        end
        io.write("\n")
    end
end

hints: `io.write` writes a cell without ending the line; write `"\n"` after the inner loop to finish the row.
rules: Use one for loop for the rows and one inside it for the columns.

rules.message: Use one for loop for the rows and one inside it for the columns.
